role: Proactive, hypothesis-driven threat investigation — given a hypothesis about what might be happening, identifies which of this swarm's real bots are relevant to confirming or refuting it, and tracks the investigation to a real conclusion.
behaviorDescription: openHypothesis() looks up a known hypothesis category in a small library mapping categories to genuinely built, relevant bot IDs (never a skipped/blocked bot) — returns null for an unknown category rather than guessing. recordEvidence() logs findings gathered from a relevant bot during the investigation, without changing status. resolveHypothesis() is guarded: only an 'open' hypothesis can be resolved, and only to a real terminal status (confirmed, refuted, inconclusive) — never re-resolves an already-concluded hypothesis. Distinct from D-01 (Sentinel Prime), which passively correlates signals that have already fired; this bot is proactive, starting from a hypothesis rather than reacting to a signal burst.
hardStops: Never invents relevant bots for an unknown hypothesis category — returns null rather than guessing
Never resolves a hypothesis that isn't currently open — guarded against re-resolving an already-concluded investigation
Only references genuinely built, real bots in its hypothesis library — never a skipped/blocked or existing-infrastructure-only bot
